title: Serre's conditions (R_k) and (S_k)
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and $k\ge0$ an integer. For a prime ideal $\mathfrak p\subset R$ let $R_{\mathfrak p}$ be the localization at $\mathfrak p$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], a local ring with maximal ideal $\mathfrak pR_{\mathfrak p}$; let $\dim(R_{\mathfrak p})$ be its Krull dimension [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring], and call $\dim(R_{\mathfrak p})$ the *height* of $\mathfrak p$; let $\operatorname{depth}(R_{\mathfrak p})$ be the depth of the local ring $R_{\mathfrak p}$, i.e. of $R_{\mathfrak p}$ as a module over itself [def-weil-pbc-depth]. (1) $R$ has property *$(R_k)$* (one also says $R$ is *regular in codimension $\le k$*) if for every prime $\mathfrak p\subset R$ of height $\le k$ the local ring $R_{\mathfrak p}$ is a regular local ring [def-weil-regular-scheme]. (2) $R$ has property *$(S_k)$* if for every prime $\mathfrak p\subset R$ the local ring $R_{\mathfrak p}$ has $\operatorname{depth}(R_{\mathfrak p})\ge\min\{k,\dim(R_{\mathfrak p})\}$.
